We return to the room of Elena Syrell, as random objects float around, Reister attempted to steal her Balthazaar dagger, and she took notice. Ivys abruptly shouted out "LADY SYRELL ARE YOU AWARE THERE IS A BALTHAZAAR SUICIDE DAGGER ON YOUR TABLE!"

Elena stares blankly at Ivys, her eyes slowly panning between each of you. Her gaze hardens as her brow furrows, and she looks into all of your eyes intensely. The room slowly darkens, as her eyes start to glow with pale moonlight. "I am not your enemy, and I need you all to leave, please. Now."

If they protest, she will simply say, "I cannot, I, you simply must leave. Trust me."

After that they depart they return to their rooms. It is the night before convergence.
